question: Quais os 3 estados com maior receita total gerada pelos vendedores cadastrados?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    seller_state, 
    ROUND(SUM(total_revenue_generated), 2) AS state_seller_revenue 
FROM marts.dim_sellers 
GROUP BY seller_state 
ORDER BY state_seller_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 3;
